notes.title: Isekai Spa Simulator "Magical Massage” first PV release! Playtest starts now!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468587/7056de68b8798f153b0a11b2c2d9069d8a5f5212.png"]

Ever wondered if hemorrhoids could cause earthquakes? Or if massage could cure them? Or if the treatment might put your life at risk?

Hello, players! This is Pop Elephant here!

The public playtest of Magical Massage is now live on Steam!

Head over to the game page to request access and be among the first to experience this bizarre and absurd magical massage adventure!

In the game, you take on the role of a massage therapist who specializes in treating magicians’ most embarrassing conditions—like hemorrhoids that trigger earthquakes or explosive sinusitis. With your divine hands, it’s all up to you to save the day!

Each client will also start rambling nonsense under your hypnosis (uh... maybe this is the perfect time to upsell them on a VIP membership^^)

Currently, Magical Massage is still in early development, and some parts are being refined. If you encounter any bugs or have eager feedback and suggestions while playing, feel free to join our official QQ group 1046610890. Who knows—your brilliant ideas might make it into the final version of the game!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468587/07374dcd78b8b7c6809311928179e20eb9a05de8.png"]

We’ve worked hard to improve the game based on feedback from the first test! In this round, several new massageable characters have been added, and we hope they bring you a fresh experience!

notes.title: Version 1.3.2 Update
notes.notes:
New Features

 Option to skip the opening cutscene
 Pointer operation difficulty option (can be slowed down)
 Pointer movement changed to back-and-forth motion
 Initial quantity set to 1 when purchasing items
 Volume adjustment range reduced (to prevent audio clipping) and can be lowered further
 Naming prompt (defaults to a preset name if left blank)
 Debuff flashing effect
 Default shop name set to "Massage Master"
 High affection service panel (although it can't be accessed in the demo version, players complained that it was too empty, so it will be displayed)


Fixed Bugs

 Character panel name does not display custom names
 Fixed fullscreen issue after the opening cutscene
 Storage panel has no display at the start
 Consecutive clicks may cause checkout failure at massage ending


Potentially Fixed Bugs

 Character panel remains displayed after a massage session

notes.title: Version 1.3.1 Update
notes.notes:
Confirmed bug fixes and new features:

 Added a tutorial
 Added material descriptions when selecting clients (part of the tutorial)
 The protagonist's portrait now appears before entering a custom name
 Added a confirmation prompt when selecting materials for clients
 Difficulty no longer affects prices (starting funds were adjusted instead due to decimal formatting issues)
 Fatigue calculation hidden
 The demo version allowing gameplay up to the second week


Temporary fix:
 Fixed a crash when starting a second playthrough (previously, restarting the second playthrough in-game caused a crash; now, reaching a bad ending will directly close the program)
